cv.profile: I am looking for my first software role in a team where I can contribute and learn. I understand code, but I still need AI assistance to write it. I use coding assistants to build projects, then run the result, test its behaviour and work through problems. I am improving both my coding fundamentals and the way I use AI. projects.name: API Contract Guard
projects.detail: A bounded command-line tool for comparing a defined OpenAPI subset. I set the supported change categories, expected reports and failure boundaries, then reviewed the AI-assisted implementation and test cases. It covers five documented breaking-change categories and fails closed outside scope.

projects.name: EvidenceDesk
projects.meta: React · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Redis · Synthetic data
projects.detail: A document-review prototype that links answers to supporting pages and can abstain when evidence is missing. Recall@5 reached 100% on 25 of 25 answerable synthetic cases; the wider answer evaluation did not pass (36% accuracy and 45.67% extraction F1), so the limit remains visible.

projects.name: Synthevia
projects.detail: A local learning and research workspace built with AI assistance. The public sample connects a React interface to a FastAPI backend and SQLite data. It uses fictional data; external services are not connected.

letter.subject: Open application · Junior software / backend / applied AI
paragraphs: I am looking for my first role in software development or applied AI. I started in business studies, then became interested in building software through my own projects. I would like to take that work further in a team where I can learn from experienced developers.

I understand code, but I still need AI assistance to write it. I describe what I want to build, work through the implementation with coding assistants and check the result by running it and testing its behaviour. I am getting better at using these tools and working on my coding fundamentals at the same time.

My portfolio includes API Contract Guard, a TypeScript tool with 102 recorded local tests, and EvidenceDesk, a document-review prototype with source citations. EvidenceDesk also has an answer evaluation that did not pass, which is documented in the repository. Synthevia shows a smaller React and FastAPI workspace using fictional data. These personal projects give us something concrete to discuss.

I am available for full-time work and plan to study computer science online alongside it. The institution is not yet finalised. I would value clear expectations, regular code review and the chance to contribute while learning.
I would be glad to walk you through one of my projects, explain how I built it and discuss whether my current level fits what your team needs.
